simple: Cyber risk exposure management (CREM): builds an inventory of the company’s assets — computers, servers, cloud resources, accounts and what is visible from the internet — and scores the risk of each based on criticality and active threats. Discovers internet-facing resources (Attack Surface Discovery), manages vulnerabilities and dangerous misconfigurations with priorities, scans network devices for vulnerabilities (Network Vulnerability Scanner) and assesses account risk (Identity Security Posture): accounts without MFA, stale accounts and those with excessive permissions. Also predicts attack paths to critical assets, trains employees and runs phishing simulations (Security Awareness), and automates compliance reporting. Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
